fallow.lune.efface: The moon fades. Another presence holds the sky tonight.
fallow.lune.note.1: "Deep in the ruins, a moon's face is carved into the stone.
fallow.lune.note.2: I looked at it for a long time. In the nights after, I dreamed of her.
fallow.lune.note.3: Since then, a shadow in the sky shows me a path."
fallow.sante.coeur_ancien: The Elderheart leaves a shard of life in your hands.
fallow.sante.plein: Your health is already whole: %s hearts.
fallow.sante.reveil: You wake up weaker. %s hearts remain.
fallow.sante.reveil_plancher: You wake up. %s hearts remain; you will grow no weaker.
tooltip.fallow.peau_brute: Craft it with ash to prepare it.
tooltip.fallow.peau_preparee: Soak it on a Bamboo Tray, in the rain or under a dripping stalactite.
